description: DPSYOR: Dataset for Power SYstem Oscillation Responses is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Menuka KC, Deepak Joshi. "Deployment of wide-area monitoring systems (WAMS) and phasor measurement units (PMUs) in modern power systems has enabled the collection of vast amounts of real-time data. These datasets can be effectively leveraged to enhance system reliability assessment, detect potential disturbances, and identify transmission failures. While certain events, such as oscillations, occur infrequently,but causes severe system-wide consequences. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
